data.description: The contents of the current page.

next.description: URL to the next page, if more data may be available.

cursor.description: Globally unique reference to this specific audit log item

organizationId.description: ID of the target organization, or the target account's parent organization

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the event which triggered the audit log occurred

serviceName.description: Identifier for the service which triggered the audit log

message.description: Short human-readable description of the event

sandbox.description: Whether the target account is a sandbox or production account

userId.description: ID of the user who performed the action

messageId.description: Unique ID identifying this audit event

referenceId.description: Reference ID used to correlate multiple events happening on the same resource

eventType.description: Identifier for this kind of audit event

clientId.description: ID of the client used to perform the action

jwtId.description: ID of the JWT used to authenticate the user or client

expiresAt.description: Timestamp of when this audit log will be permanently deleted from our systems

data.description: Additional arbitrary data specific to this audit event

indexedData.description: Additional arbitrary data specific to this audit event which is queryable

mayHaveMoreData.description: If true, there may be more data available for this audit log by calling the cursor endpoint.
